entries.1a7c352f83bd0524: Under its mission of 'providing new experiences through "knowing," "connecting" and "expressing," and enriching people's lives,' the company states that it will work to expand its business centered on three services: Content Platform Service, Content Marketing Service and Technology Solutions Service. Regarding the outflow of funds caused by unauthorized remittance instructions that occurred in April 2026, following recommendations from a special investigation committee, the company has made thorough strengthening of its governance and internal control systems and the implementation and establishment of recurrence prevention measures its top management priority. In the manga field, it states that it will promote adoption of the app version of 'GigaViewer,' the full-scale launch of the customer acquisition support service 'Comic Growth powered by GigaViewer,' expanded sales of Mackerel's APM function, and expansion of the scope of support for toitta.

entries.662b0b89066e6bea: This segment provides UGC services that allow users to publish and spread content. The company operates services including “Hatena Bookmark”, which lets users register and share web pages, and “Hatena Blog”, which can be set up for free, and the number of registered users was 13.28 million as of July 2026. The company earns revenue from paid-plan subscription fees, commissions from paid sales of articles, and affiliate advertising revenue. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥319 million.

The manga viewer “GigaViewer” has been adopted by publishers including Shueisha Inc.’s “Shonen Jump+”, and the company also co-develops KADOKAWA Corporation’s novel posting site “Kakuyomu” and develops game-linked services for Nintendo Co., Ltd. The company also provides “Mackerel”, an observability platform that monitors servers and applications. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended July 2026 was ¥2,780 million.
